labels.notes: A verbatim hoist with no statement or proof-term change. Base: git log shows lean-causal unchanged between 73eb9a1 and HEAD a809fb1 (git diff 73eb9a1 HEAD -- lean-causal is empty), and Causal/Model/QuasilinearOneSided.lean was last changed in 9bda56f. TEXT. HEAD :186-340 (`namespace Causality` ... `end Causality`, 155 lines) was cut from `git show HEAD:` and compared with cmp to InextensiblePiece.lean :77-231: byte-identical. As a byte string the block occurs exactly once in the new file and nowhere in the edited QuasilinearOneSided. The new module repeats HEAD's prelude (:72-74 = HEAD :97-99, `namespace Causal`, `open Set TopologicalSpace Topology Filter Metric`). At HEAD the only scope commands between :99 and :186 are inside the closed `section SlopeCone`, so nothing in scope at HEAD is missing. ENVIRONMENT, independent of /tmp/hinx. HEAD's QuasilinearOneSided was compiled from a /tmp copy under its real name (`lake env lean -DwarningAsError=true -R <tmp> -o <tmp>.olean`) into a /tmp mirror of the other Causal oleans, with Causal.InextensiblePiece left out. One `lean --run` process imported both versions and compared every constant whose module is under Causal by Expr.== on type and value. It also compared binder names (macro scopes erased) and binder infos, levels, `all`, definition hints and safety, inductive, constructor and recursor data, reducibility, protected, noncomputable, instance status, matcher info and the docstring. (a) `import Causal.Model.QuasilinearOneSided`: HEAD has 2719 Causal constants in 39 modules, the working tree 2719 in 40. Removed 0, added 0. Module only: exactly 5, futureInextensible_of_isLUB_notMem, pastInextensible_of_isGLB_notMem, inextensible_connectedComponentIn, inextensible_connectedComponentIn.match_1_1 and IsCauchySurfaceOn.exists_mem_connectedComponentIn (all Causal.Causality.*), each from Causal.Model.QuasilinearOneSided to Causal.InextensiblePiece. Other changes: 0. (b) `import Causal.InextensiblePiece` alone: 1408 constants in 28 modules, every one equal to HEAD's apart from the module of the same 5. (c) The whole library, all 254 imports of Causal.lean: 14899 Causal constants on both sides, removed 0, added 0, the same 5 module-only, 0 other. The result is the same with the master's proposed root line, `import Causal.InextensiblePiece` before `import Causal.Model.QuasilinearOneSided`. The comparator can fail: it reports the value change of the mathlib-only import variant below. The closer's before_qos.tsv was regenerated with its own DumpBody.lean over my HEAD mirror and is byte-identical to /tmp/hinx/dump/before_qos.tsv, so its 'before' record is confirmed. The four statements: a Causality on a topological M, [T2Space M], W : Opens M, curves ℝ → M, a continuous T : M → ℝ, IsOpen/IsLUB/IsGLB of a set of ℝ, Icc, connectedComponentIn (ℓ ⁻¹' W) t, CausalCurveIn/On, Future/Past/Inextensible, IsCauchySurfaceOn. The only metric-named constants in their types are Real.pseudoMetricSpace and PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace, which are ℝ's own topology. Metric.ball occurs only in the matcher's type, a ball of ℝ. No metric notion on the spacetime. No paper label is concerned, and the new module marks nothing (no ``**`…`**`` of a label; the bold runs are theorem headings in declaration docstrings, HEAD text). QuasilinearOneSided's kept mark on **`T-loc-quasilinear-one-sided/3-inextensible-piece`** is accurate. The statement is still certified in full: same name, type and proof term, no sorry, standard axioms, in the module's import closure. The added sentence ('hoisted with its three companions, same names, into the ETT-layer `Causal.InextensiblePiece` (T-abs-hoist-inextensible-piece), which this module imports') is true. The REPORT discloses this as a reading in notes (3). No tool reads the mark: tools/ledger.py:246-248 reads only `prefix:`-form paper labels, and no curation, binder or ledger names the target label.

build.details: Run from lean-causal/. `pgrep -af 'lake build'` was empty, and no `lake build` was needed or run. `taskset -c 0-11 lake env lean -DwarningAsError=true` on Causal/InextensiblePiece.lean and on Causal/Model/QuasilinearOneSided.lean: exit 0, no output, for each. `lake build --no-build Causal.InextensiblePiece Causal.Model.QuasilinearOneSided`: 'All targets up-to-date (3117 jobs)'. Oleans newer than the closer's before dump: Causal/InextensiblePiece.olean and Causal/Model/QuasilinearOneSided.olean, plus CausalScaffold/GHWithoutTarentin.olean and OneWayMembraneChronal.olean, which belong to the two other closers. No mathlib or other Causal module was rebuilt. scripts/sorry_count.py: strict 0 in 255 files. In the two files `sorry` occurs only in the docstring heading '(no `sorry`)', and there is no admit, axiom, native_decide, implemented_by or extern. A #print axioms probe (written under the campaign directory and deleted) gives [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] for each of the 5 constants of Causal.InextensiblePiece, which has exactly those 5 constants. IMPORTS (kb/0083). Each variant was compiled in /tmp as AuditVar.Vn: the module body from its line 71 under a candidate import list, `-DwarningAsError=true`, then compared structurally with HEAD by the same comparator. (1) The module's own set, Causal.Inextensible + Causal.Cauchy + Causal.LadderLocal: identical to HEAD (5 module-only, 0 other). (2) HEAD QuasilinearOneSided's five imports: identical (calibration). (3) Causal.Cauchy alone, and Causal.Inextensible + Causal.Cauchy: do not elaborate. :114:25 and :115:25 give 'failed to synthesize LocallyConnectedSpace ℝ' at `hO.connectedComponentIn`. (4) Causal.Cauchy + Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Basic + Mathlib.Analysis.LocallyConvex.WithSeminorms: elaborates, and inextensible_connectedComponentIn has a different value with the same type. Its used constants gain ContinuousMul.to_continuousSMul and IsTopologicalSemiring.toContinuousMul and lose IsModuleTopology.toContinuousSMul and IsTopologicalSemiring.toIsModuleTopology. (5) Adding Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Module.ModuleTopology to (4): identical. The HEAD term's LocallyConnectedSpace ℝ path is instLocallyConnectedSpace, LocallyConvexSpace.toLocPathConnectedSpace, NormedSpace.toLocallyConvexSpace, InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace, RCLike.toInnerProductSpaceReal, as the REPORT says. So the kb/0083 finding holds: a narrower import set changes the proof term of inextensible_connectedComponentIn, and the chosen set restores HEAD's. The three mathlib modules, LocPathConnected and Gaussian.Real are in the closures of Causal.LadderLocal (27 Causal modules), Causal.MeasureRemarks, Causal.NestedCausalities and Causal.CurveComponents, and not in those of Causal.Cauchy (16) or Causal.Measure (6). (6) The remark on Causal.Cauchy + Causal.CurveComponents is true: every constant has HEAD's type and value, and the closure is smaller. That closure has 22 Causal modules without the module itself, the same as Causal.CurveComponents alone, against 27 for the chosen set. In that narrower closure, two realised congruence lemmas, Causal.Causality.mk.congr_simp and Causal.Precausality.mk.congr_simp, are attributed to Causal.MeasureRemarks instead of Causal.LinesReachable. Their types and values are identical; only the attribution of a subsumed duplicate changes, which is harmless. LAYER 1. Compiled closure of Causal.InextensiblePiece: 28 Causal modules including itself, equal to the REPORT's list. None of them is Causal.Minkowski, Causal.Static, Causal.Flat.*, Causal.Model.*, Causal.Port.*, Causal.SingularFlat, Causal.CBG*, Causal.Splitting*, Causal.LemmaK* or Causal.LevinUtility. tools/ladder.py model_path('Causal.InextensiblePiece', lean_index()['imports']) is None, and the source closure also has 28 modules. ETT layer after: 73 of 255. Before it was 72 of 254, since QuasilinearOneSided is Causal.Model.* and no module but the root imports it. DUPLICATES (kb/0082). Each of the four names has one declaration, at Causal/InextensiblePiece.lean:86, :159, :174, :222. A grep of theorem/lemma/def/abbrev/instance over lean-causal/Causal, lean-causal/scaffold, lean-gx, lean-benzecri, lean-egf and lean-syracuse finds no other. In every compared environment each name occurs once with module Causal.InextensiblePiece. Remaining mentions are in QuasilinearOneSided: docstring :33, :190-192, :211, and the use at :232 (hS.exists_mem_connectedComponentIn). MASTER_CHANGES. papers/*/certificate (curation.toml everywhere, binder.toml of ers-predictability and sbierski-mghd), every papers/*/ledger and programme/ladder.toml name none of the moved declarations. The only mention of the old file is papers/ers-predictability/certificate/curation.toml:207 (erslem:PropertyTimelike, extra_lean_files) for ers_lemma_4_86 and ers_lemma_4_86_oneSidedBoundary, which stayed. tools/ledger.py:601-603 only appends that file to the row's lean_files, so it needs no change. QUASILINEARONESIDED. HEAD with :186-340 removed was diffed against the working file. It differs only by the `import Causal.InextensiblePiece` line (:6), the 3-inextensible-piece bullet (:32-36), the SCOPE 'Imports' bullet (:92-95) and the section-2 header with its pointer paragraph (:187-193). Everything else is byte-identical, 1021 -> 874 lines, 15 insertions and 162 deletions. DOCSTRING CONTRACT (kb/0006) of the new module. Title present. No mark ('Nothing is marked', true). The quote of def:cauchy_surface is verbatim from ETT.tex:999-1000. DEC-11, DEC-13 and DEC-14 are cited correctly (registers/DECISIONS.md:22, :24, :25). The hypothesis checklist matches the statement of inextensible_connectedComponentIn and its proof. SCOPE is true on each point: the verbatim hoist with its line ranges, the matcher, the import reason (checked above) and the sibling left in EAlphaCauchy. Provenance line present. SCOPE (git). findings.what: Two readings of the closer's import probes are wrong. (1) 'Causal.Cauchy + Causal.Measure: inextensible_connectedComponentIn differs (value 3510311563 against 1667507348)' is false. That import list does not elaborate: it gives the same 'failed to synthesize LocallyConnectedSpace ℝ' error as Causal.Cauchy alone (reproduced, :115:25). The hash is that of Lean's error-recovery term: in the reproduction the value has hasSorry = true, and the closer's own /tmp/hinx/probe/h_meas.tsv carries the error's 'Hint:' line. The genuine changed-term case is the mathlib-only list (InnerProductSpace.Basic + LocallyConvex.WithSeminorms), which the REPORT also gives, correctly. (2) 'a smaller closure (22 Causal modules against 28)' compares a count without the module itself to one with it. Like for like it is 22 against 27, or 23 against 28. The terms are indeed identical, as claimed.
findings.fix: In the journal, and in any kb/0083 line taken from this REPORT, write: 'Causal.Cauchy + Causal.Measure does not elaborate (LocallyConnectedSpace ℝ), like Causal.Cauchy alone' and '22 against 27 Causal modules, the module itself excluded'. No Lean change.
